description: How well the system finds the right context before generating — the foundation of any RAG product.
Quality of the produced answer: grounded, relevant, correct, and consistent across changes.
Reliability of prompts and resistance to adversarial input as prompts are versioned and exposed.
Whether agents use tools, complete tasks, plan, hand off and recall memory successfully.
Harm prevention and appropriate refusal — table stakes for any consumer-facing surface.
Governance of the data assets feeding AI: classification, PII, quality, metadata and lineage.
Governance of AI decisions: explainability, traceability, human oversight and auditability.
Detecting distribution shift in inputs and predictions once models run in production.
Runtime health: latency, responsiveness, availability and error rates.
Token usage and unit economics — central to model selection and local-LLM planning.
Does it move the needle? Adoption, satisfaction and measurable business impact.
